transactions_transfer_check.name: transactions_transfer_check
transactions_transfer_check.value:
("transactions"."kind" = 'transfer' and "transactions"."to_wallet_id" is not null and "transactions"."to_wallet_id" <> "transactions"."wallet_id")
        or ("transactions"."kind" <> 'transfer' and "transactions"."to_wallet_id" is null)
